title: Just Too Small
text:
Just Too Small. Note: There are multiple products attached to this listing. I am specifically reviewing the 0.55lb. pan with striped lid.

I have been baking breads from scratch for many years and I was very interested in trying this pan, especially after recently breaking one of my glass loaf pans. I have worked with other Chefmade pans and each I have used has been of good quality and worked well, so I had elevated expectations. I was surprised when this loaf pan arrived – it’s much smaller than I expected.

First, the positives. This is a nice little pan that seems to be very well-made. It feels solid, and the non-stick surface (not Teflon) feels almost slippery. Nothing is going to stick to this pan. I have not tried this, but I believe I could make hard candy in this little pan and it would not stick. Breads baked in this pan slip right out and are properly browned on all sides. It’s easy to clean.

However… This loaf pan is about 4.5” square which makes a very, very small loaf, too small for much more than novelty presentation or making in large quantities for gifting (and then you need multiple pans anyway). I did not realize it would be as small at it is before it arrived.

For me, this pan is just too small to be useful. The larger size might be more in line with what I would use. If you like small, gifting-sized loaves that look really nice and you like non-stick bakeware, this is a decent option. If you’re making bread to make a week’s worth of sandwiches, this isn’t the best choice.
